title: Sovereign X Temporal Idea Governance — Common Constitutional Lifecycle
statusNote: Epoch classification heuristics are unit-tested (tested). System-wide CI-* mapping into JCK/COS/CER/ERS/RAC is declared only — no CKL/runtime gate enforces PTIG. Drive-G-1: do not claim enforcement.

statusVocabulary.enforced: Implemented, unit-tested, and invoked on a real deny/accept execution path.
statusVocabulary.tested: Unit tests pass for the stated heuristic; no production gate.
statusVocabulary.declared: Specified in prose/JSON only, or aspirational system-wide framing without implementation proof.

guarantees.title: Continuity (preservation)
guarantees.statement: No idea loses identity, lineage, provenance, or context. Ideas may remain inactive indefinitely.
guarantees.note: Preservation must NOT imply constitutional acceptance.

guarantees.title: Acceptance (activation)
guarantees.statement: Only evidence-backed ideas become constitutional artifacts when invariants, predicates, and evidence satisfy activation criteria.
activationCriteriaRefs: PI-* pass on ConformanceReport (shape compatible with acceptConformanceReport)
AcceptanceDecision.verdict in {accept} with optional soft-or-enforce mode
CROS CI-004/CI-005 evidence and profile-scoped replay honesty where applicable

epochs.label: Substrate
epochs.description: Idea identity and context exist on the substrate. Continuity only — not activated.

epochs.label: Substration
epochs.description: Idea is bound into substrate records (lineage/provenance placeholders). Continuity only — still inactive.

epochs.label: Promotion
epochs.description: Evidence candidates may be attached. Does not activate; does not imply AcceptanceGuarantee.

epochs.label: Activation
epochs.description: Requires acceptance criteria: PI-* / ConformanceReport / soft-or-enforce AcceptanceDecision. Continuity alone is insufficient.

activityStates.label: Preserved but inactive
activityStates.note: Default for substrate/substration; also valid after promotion without activation.

routingRules.note: Heuristic declared + unit-tested as denied/declared; not a CKL policy in default.policies.json.

routingRules.when: any epoch before activation, or activation criteria unmet
epoch is activation AND evidence predicates pass

cros.note: CI-* are CROS package-local invariants (partial validators). Mapping them as system-wide guarantees is declared framing, not enforcement.

piContracts.acceptanceHook: acceptConformanceReport shape (duck-typed reference; no hard import cycle from PTIG)

systemWideGuaranteeAcronyms.note: Proposal maps CI-* into JCK, COS, CER, ERS, RAC as system-wide guarantees (not render-only). In-repo expansions found only for CER (content evidence) in genblaze-media constitutional docs. JCK, COS, ERS, RAC appear without expansions — do not invent them. Framing remains declared until code proves enforcement.

nonClaims: PTIG is not full CKL enforcement.
